themes_detail.label: Lead Dust Construction Surge
themes_detail.summary: Construction lead dust complaints spiked to 3 THIS WEEK (vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks)—a 700% increase—coinciding with 102 new building permits filed in the district over 90 days, raising acute health risks for children in Morris Park/Pelham Parkway.
evidence: 3 construction lead dust complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 5.42)
102 new building permits filed in past 90 days, 173 alteration permits in pipeline
NYC children under 6 in high-construction areas face elevated lead exposure risk
reporting_angles: Are contractors following NYC lead-safe work practices during this building boom? Interview DOB enforcement and affected families.
Map the 102 new permits against lead dust complaint clusters—is there geographic overlap?

themes_detail.label: Traffic Congestion Spike
themes_detail.summary: Traffic complaints jumped to 4 THIS WEEK (vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks)—an 700% spike—suggesting a sudden congestion or transit disruption event in Morris Park/Pelham Parkway.
evidence: 4 traffic complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average (z-score: 4.95)
Timing coincides with completed Bronx Metro-North mapping projects (Marconi Street Bridge, Marconi Street Widening)
No Reddit or local news mentions yet—signal not yet visible to mainstream coverage
reporting_angles: Are the recently completed Metro-North infrastructure projects causing new bottlenecks on Marconi Street or Morris Park Avenue?
Interview DOT and MTA about post-construction traffic impact monitoring.

themes_detail.label: Street & Curb Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Curb condition complaints surged to 4 THIS WEEK (vs. 0.8 weekly average)—a 433% spike—paired with ongoing street condition complaints (549 over 90 days) and repeated community board requests for streetscape improvements, indicating accelerating pavement failure.
evidence: 4 curb condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly average (z-score: 4.91)
549 street condition complaints over 90-day period (4th-largest complaint category)
Repeated community board streetscape improvement requests in budget data—unsolved multi-year problem
reporting_angles: Walk the highest-complaint blocks (Morris Park Ave, Pelham Parkway) and photograph curb/street conditions; compare to DOT maintenance schedules.
Interview CB members: What specific intersections are most damaged, and why haven't streetscape funds been allocated?

themes_detail.label: Encampment & Drug Activity Cluster
themes_detail.summary: Encampment and drug activity complaints each hit 5 LAST WEEK (vs. 0.4 weekly average)—a 1233% spike each—suggesting a new or expanding street-level crisis in a specific location within the district.
evidence: 5 encampment complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 6.65)
5 drug activity complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 6.65)
No Reddit discussions or local news yet—early-stage story not yet picked up by competitors
reporting_angles: Geo-locate the 5 encampment and 5 drug complaints to identify hotspot; interview NYPD and outreach services about conditions and response.
Follow up with community members near Pelham Parkway or Morris Park Ave on safety concerns and city services availability.

themes_detail.label: Illegal Fireworks Decline (Previous Crisis)
themes_detail.summary: Illegal fireworks complaints spiked 3 weeks ago (11 vs. 0.1 weekly average—8700% increase) but have since subsided, indicating a time-limited event (likely holiday-related) rather than an ongoing crisis.
evidence: 11 illegal fireworks complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.1 weekly average (z-score: 32.88)—highest z-score in dataset
Spike appears to have resolved; no mention of elevated complaints this week
Likely seasonal/holiday-driven event, not indicative of current conditions
reporting_angles: Retrospective: Was there a major holiday or event 3 weeks ago? Interview NYPD about enforcement actions taken.
Monitor for recurrence around upcoming holidays; establish baseline for comparison.
